lead.headline: Google ships a Gemini agent that plans work and picks its own model
lead.summary: At Gemini at Work, Google Cloud launched a universal work agent that takes objectives, uses tools and skills, and connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, Git, BigQuery and MCP servers. It can route to Gemini or Anthropic Claude (more models later), gets its own Workspace account for audit trails, and starts with businesses before consumers. Early testers include On, Shopify and PayPal; Gemini has over 1B monthly users and nearly 90% of Fortune 100 use Gemini Enterprise.

number_of_day.label: Planned investment by French AI infrastructure firm Sesterce in a data-centre campus at the former Kaipola mill in Jämsä, Finland — starting at 200 MW, expanding to 600 MW, with construction due before year-end.

news.headline: Sesterce plans a €10B AI data centre in Jämsä
news.summary: The French firm will reuse the old UPM Kaipola mill site, pledging one megawatt of new Finnish renewables for every megawatt the campus uses within ten years. The CEO told Yle a deal with one of the world's two leading AI labs is signed; Google and atNorth already have large Finland projects underway.

news.headline: Anthropic puts Claude on grids and open-source CVE hunting
news.summary: Its Critical Infrastructure Defense Program brings frontier models and engineers to firms protecting power and water systems, with eleven founding partners from consulting, OT security and industrial vendors. OSS Scanner gives eligible open-source projects free periodic scans; early wolfSSL trials turned five of 74 reports into CVEs.

news.headline: OpenAI bans Russian and Iranian false-front influence ops
news.summary: Accounts used ChatGPT to staff a Latin American 'think tank', fake leaked docs, and seven invented journalist bylines that placed nearly 100 articles. One Russian campaign reached a European Parliament member after a staged school event in Peru; Iranian ops focused on the US–Iran war.

news.headline: GPT-6 Intelligent UI turns answers into charts and forms
news.summary: ChatGPT can now stream interactive calculators, diagrams and maps inside a reply, with Plus through Enterprise first and Free/Go starting Oct 8. OpenAI says GPT-6 Instant begins web-search answers 44% sooner on average than GPT-5.6 Instant; it works on web and updated apps, not Pro effort or older desktop apps.
